item.title: Constant flytipping in Durfey Place, 19th August
item.description:
Fly-tipping at Durfey Place (SE5 7QD) remains a persistent and recurring problem. It is now happening almost daily and continues to affect residents’ quality of life. This issue has been reported repeatedly through FixMyStreet and has also been raised through the Council’s complaints process. It is currently referred to the Local Government and Social Care Ombudsman under case ID 26003793. The concern is not only that waste keeps appearing, but that the Council has not followed through on the longer-term preventative action previously discussed through the Fly-tipping Working Group. Residents were told that CCTV or equivalent monitoring would be considered. However, the Council’s Stage 2 response accepted that there was no proper handover after the responsible officer left and that records of agreed actions could not be located. Please therefore do not treat this as a routine one-off clearance request only. Please arrange removal of the waste and confirm what action is being taken to prevent repeated fly-tipping at this location, including who is now accountable for progressing the matter and when residents will receive a clear update. Requests for updates on the working group and the promised preventative action have not received a substantive response, leaving residents without a clear plan, accountable officer or timetable. This report is being made as further evidence that the issue remains live and unresolved.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 61, Edmund Street, Camberwell, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
